root_cause: The public language switch contained an unintended navigation branch for unprefixed public routes. That made English switching depend on a separate /en/* route even though the runtime contract intended in-place switching, surfacing the user-visible language failure on pricing.
prevention: Unprefixed public routes switch locale in place and must not depend on /en/* route availability.
Locale-prefixed static routes remain valid direct-entry routes and may navigate between locale prefixes.
Production proof must execute the actual pricing language control and confirm visible English copy with no language-failure banner.
A source-code fix is not LIVE_BEWEZEN until the exact production SHA and browser interaction gate both pass.
